source_commit_subject: fix(ci): restore Rust gates and record UDP fault coverage
source_scope: 21 selected production, ABI, test and build inputs match the Linux workspace byte-for-byte; not a hermetic whole-worktree release manifest.

execution.runtime: native root host CLI, two private MTU-1500 namespaces, one cgroup and persistent connected IPv4/IPv6 socket pairs

findings.change: Add native MSG_TRUNC and socket receive-queue overflow acceptance, independent per-namespace UDP counters and per-socket SO_RXQ_OVFL recovery receipts. Keep full packet oracles on Linux; record deterministic packet-oracle digests in this compact fixture.
findings.interpretation: A cgroup ingress observation precedes receive-queue admission in these runs. It does not prove application delivery or full application reads. Socket queue drops and application truncation are not collector loss.
development_attempts: attempt-1: initial native run passed; excluded from final repeats after adding exact UDP InDatagrams/OutDatagrams and error-counter checks
regressions: errors-regression: dual-stack local EMSGSIZE, remote ECONNREFUSED and socket reuse passed
lifecycle-regression: actual collector overflow and fault recovery passed
findings.raw_packet_oracles: Each run retains client/oracle.json, server/oracle.json and export.json at evidence_root. expected_sha256 hashes serde_json compact serialization of the original expected array; tests reconstruct all 144 expected observations per peer, not only the delivered subset.
